SELECT
  CASE WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 0 THEN 'Current' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END,
  CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMER_NAME,
  SUM(AR_INVOICES.OPEN_AMOUNT),
  SUM(CASE WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE > 0 THEN AR_INVOICES.OPEN_AMOUNT END),
  SUM(AR_INVOICES.INVOICE_AMOUNT),
  AVG(AR_INVOICES.DAYS_TO_PAY)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.AR_INVOICES  AR_INVOICES,
  CNR_FIN.CUSTOMERS  CUSTOMERS
WHERE
  ( AR_INVOICES.CUSTOMER_ID=CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMER_ID  )
  AND  ( AR_INVOICES.OPEN_AMOUNT > 0 )
GROUP BY
  CASE WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 0 THEN 'Current' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN AR_INVOICES.DAYS_PAST_DUE <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END,
  CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMER_NAME
